SELECT WHERE: SQL query with WHERE clause to filter data
vmstat: system monitoring command for memory, swap, CPU
ab -n 100 -c 10: Apache Benchmark command to load test an endpoint
EXPLAIN SELECT: SQL command to analyze query execution plan
ALTER TABLE ADD INDEX: SQL command to add an index for faster querying
docker-compose up -d: launches containerized environment with backend services
create_tenant_db: creates a new database instance for a tenant
migrate_tenant_schema: applies database migrations for a tenant
seed_tenant_data: populates initial tenant data in database
web-push generate-vapid-keys: generates VAPID keys for push notifications
docker-compose up test: spins up containerized environment for regression tests
rollup: bundles and optimizes components for npm
node: runs JavaScript scripts or backend server tasks
php artisan: runs Laravel commands for scaffolding and controllers
ausearch -m USER_LOGIN: searches audit logs for user login events
purge_cdn_cache: clears cached content across CDN nodes
cat: concatenate and display file contents command
gtail: display last lines of a file command
split: split file into smaller files command
head: display first lines/bytes of a file command
date: display or set system date/time command
xctool: Xcode build and test automation command
dd: copy and convert files or block devices command
title: set terminal title
